proposal.need_summary: Customer Success wants an AI assistant to draft support replies and summarize ticket history for 20 customer-success agents, integrating with their HelpDeskly ticketing system.

overlap_assessment.reason: Same vendor and category (General AI), company-wide scope with 150 seats already licensed. The justification ('draft support replies and summarize ticket history') names no capability missing from the existing NeuralDesk Business license, so this is a new product/tier for a need an existing product already serves. Caveat: SW009 is 'Approved - limited use' with sensitive-data restrictions, so it may not cover the customer_pii data class without Security/Privacy review; the human reviewer should confirm with the requester whether the existing license covers this use.
HelpDeskly is the ticketing system the requested AI assistant would integrate with; it is not an AI drafting/summarization tool, so it is related but not a substitute for the stated need.

vendor_observations: Registry: NeuralDesk (V009) registered, procurement Approved, security Approved (review 2026-03-02, 212 days old, current), legal terms Approved.
Vendor-risk API: risk level medium; processes personal data = true; stores data outside region = true.
No conflict between registry and API; both current and cleared.
Vendor notes: 'Approved only for permitted data classes' and 'Sensitive-data use requires Security and Privacy review.'
uncertainties: Whether the existing NeuralDesk Business license (limited use) permits customer PII processing is unclear; vendor notes say sensitive-data use requires Security and Privacy review.
Whether the 150 existing NeuralDesk Business seats have unused capacity for the 20 requested users is unknown.
The exact scope of the HelpDeskly integration (data flows, PII exposure) is not specified in the request.
Urgency is marked 'high' but no business rationale for urgency is provided.

evidence.finding: Requester Mia Thompson (E005), Customer Success, IC4; product 'NeuralDesk Support Assistant' from vendor NeuralDesk, category General AI; annual cost $6,000; 20 users; data access level customer_pii; integration with HelpDeskly; urgency high; field completeness complete.
Customer Success available budget $7,000; request $6,000 is within budget, leaving $1,000 remaining after purchase.

Catalog candidate SW009 'NeuralDesk Business' (same vendor, same category General AI) is Approved - limited use, $60,000/yr, 150 seats, company-wide scope, purchased 2026-07-29 by Operations; overlap flag raised; notes: 'AI assistant; sensitive data restrictions apply'.

Catalog candidate SW007 'HelpDeskly' (Customer Support, Approved, $46,000/yr, 75 seats, Customer Success scope) matches keywords support/helpdesk/customer but has no overlap flag; the requested integration target.

Vendor NeuralDesk (V009): registry Approved, security review 2026-03-02 (212 days old, current), legal terms Approved; vendor-risk API: risk_level medium, security approved, processes_personal_data=true, stores_data_outside_region=true; no registry/API conflict; not a new vendor.

gaps: No justification for why the existing NeuralDesk Business license (150 seats, company-wide) cannot cover the stated need; no missing capability named.
HelpDeskly integration scope and whether it is approved for customer PII are not documented in the evidence.
No detail on which specific data classes the 'limited use' policy for SW009 permits or excludes.
Seat utilisation of the existing 150-seat NeuralDesk Business license is unknown.
unsupported_or_unverified: The claim that a separate 'NeuralDesk Support Assistant' product is needed is not supported; the catalog shows an existing company-wide NeuralDesk Business license that could plausibly cover the stated need.
No evidence that the HelpDeskly integration is approved for customer PII data flows.

proposal.recommendation: Route for specialist review due to customer PII processing, cross-region data storage, and existing tool overlap with NeuralDesk Business.
proposal.next_step: Route to Security, Privacy, and Legal for specialist review. Procurement should confirm with the requester whether the existing NeuralDesk Business license (SW009) can be expanded to cover this use case before proceeding with a new purchase.
